notes: Phase 1: first correct kernel, channels-outer/state-inner loop, delta/u loaded once per channel tile. Full 5-seed PASS (correct 1/1). PE=52% Vec=51% Scl=16% DMA=11% HBMrd=72MB HBMwr=7MB MFU=0%. Latency 1.5116ms = 0.832x baseline (1.258ms). HBMrd 72MB above 16MB floor suggests compiler spilling; Vec/PE co-limit. Bottleneck diagnosis: NOT purely Vector-bound as hypothesized — PE and Vec co-limit at ~50% each, DMA light.

Phase 3 screen (seeds=[42], --fast): D1a seq-tile-INNER fallback (static_range over 14 tiles of 512, [128,1] scan_init[...] carry per state, channels-outer/state-mid). Mirrors ref_v3. PE=93% Vec=83% Scl=22% DMA=13% HBMrd=16MB HBMwr=7MB. Spill killed (72MB->16MB). Slower than D1b (0.8362 vs 0.7828) -> NOT promoted; screen only.

Phase 3 PROMOTED mamba_v2: D1b seq-tile-OUTER (sequential_range over 14 tiles of 512), [n_ct,128,S] carried scan_state, array-slice initial for tiles>0 else 0, per-seq-tile store. Mirrors ref_optimized (0.7823/1.608x). Full 5-seed PASS (correct 1/1). PE=99% Vec=89% Scl=23% DMA=12% HBMrd=16MB HBMwr=7MB MFU=0%. Spill ELIMINATED (72MB->16MB floor); PE/Vec pipeline 52/51->99/89. 1.5116ms->0.7822ms = 0.832x->1.609x. Faster than D1a fallback (0.8362) beyond noise. Bottleneck now PE=99% (b/c partition-broadcast lowered to nc_matmul); DMA idle 12%. Seed-42 --fast screen was 0.7828/1.607x (consistent).

Phase 3 S1a screen (seeds=[42], --fast) DROPPED: hoist/materialize channel-independent b/c broadcast out of the 2-channel loop (state-outer reorder, B_bcast/C_bcast materialized once per state, shared across both channel tiles). PE 99%->51% (PE-active 0.774ms->0.428ms, ~halved as predicted: 896->448 broadcast matmuls) BUT latency REGRESSED 0.7822->0.8397 (+7.3%): the reorder exposes Vec as new bottleneck (89%->97%, Vec-active 0.696->0.814ms). HBMrd=16MB. Correct 1/1. Keep/drop is latency-primary -> DROPPED; mamba_v2 remains winner. Off-PE goal met directionally (PE-active halved) but win did not materialize (relocated to Vec + net regression).

Phase 3 S1b probe INFEASIBLE (compile): stride-0 partition-broadcast DMA from HBM b/c via nisa.dma_copy(dst=B_bcast[p,f], src=b[s+p*0, seq_start+f]) (partition stride 0, Codex-recommended arange-index idiom). Also rejected: nl.load(...broadcast_to) on HBM (broadcast_to needs SBUF/PSUM), TensorView.ap / TensorRef.ap (no such attr in this build). FINAL error: neuronx-cc exit 70 [NCC_IBCG901] 'BIRCodegen does not support broadcast patterns, but found one in {0,+,0}[128]'. The BIR code generator cannot lower a stride-0 partition-broadcast DMA in neuronx-cc 2.0.260476. Not a DGE/memory-space issue. -> S1b DROPPED per AC-5.2 negative.

Phase 3 S1b SBUF->SBUF fallback probe INFEASIBLE (compile): stage b/c row into [1,W] SBUF via nl.load then broadcast SBUF->SBUF with nisa.dma_copy(src=B_row[p*0,f]). SAME error: neuronx-cc exit 70 [NCC_IBCG901] 'BIRCodegen does not support broadcast patterns, {0,+,0}[128]'. Confirms the rejection is the stride-0 partition-broadcast DMA PATTERN itself (memory-space-independent), not HBM-source-specific. S1b conclusively infeasible in this build -> entire S1 lever fails (S1a regressed, S1b infeasible); mamba_v2 remains winner.

Phase 3 task11 (analyze/Codex, no kernel): S3/S4 bottleneck analysis. Codex CONFIRMS: (1) S3b/S4 standalone on mamba_v2 are expected latency NO-OPS -- PE=99% is a hard tiling-invariant floor (PE-active flat ~0.77ms == wall time across all tile widths); Vec-active ~0.70ms is BELOW PE and hidden under it, so relieving Vec/Scl (not on the critical path) cannot beat 0.78ms (offpe-transpose-hidden analog). (2) S3a scalar_tensor_tensor fuse is compile-infeasible: c_bcast is free-varying [128,512] (not [P,1]) and both c_bcast and scanC_accum are full tiles -> two full-tensor operands, which scalar_tensor_tensor cannot take. (3) The ONE worthwhile exploratory profile is S1a+S3b TOGETHER: S1a removed PE as floor (PE-active 0.428) but exposed Vec (0.814); S3b attacks that exposed Vec work (~20% fewer tensor_tensor). Recommendation: try S1a+S3b as mamba_v4; else floor-confirm mamba_v2 at 1.609x.

Phase 3 PROMOTED mamba_v4 (S1a+S3b combined): state-outer/channel-inner reorder sharing the b/c partition-broadcast across both channel tiles (halves PE broadcast matmuls) PLUS hoist state-independent deltaU=delta*u out of the 16-state loop (computed once per seq-tile/channel-tile, reused across all 16 states). Full 5-seed PASS (correct 1/1). PE 99->59%, Vec 89->95%, Scl 23->33%, DMA 12%, HBMrd 16MB (floor kept). 0.7822->0.7278ms = 1.609x->1.729x, ~7.1% faster than mamba_v2 (same-session v2 control 0.7839ms, jitter ~0.2% << the 7% delta). BEATS the 1.608x ref_optimized reference. Math/fp32 semantics unchanged (pure reorder + hoist of identical ops). Discovered via Codex analysis: S1a alone regressed (Vec-exposed) but S1a+S3b together drops the exposed Vec work below the old PE=0.77ms floor.

Phase 3 PROMOTED mamba_v5 (S4 static-unroll on mamba_v4): replace affine_range with nl.static_range on the S=16 state loop and both n_channel_tile=2 channel loops (seq carry loop stays sequential_range). Full 5-seed PASS (correct 1/1). PE61/Vec97/Scl28/DMA14/HBMrd16MB. 0.7278->0.7164ms = 1.729x->1.756x, ~1.55% faster. Sub-3% but the two same-session bands are NON-OVERLAPPING: s4unroll {0.7162,0.7164,0.7165,0.7170} vs mamba_v4 {0.7273,0.7278,0.7279,0.7280} (each ~0.1% internal jitter) -> delta clearly outside the control band. Full unroll gives the compiler a longer dependency-free instruction window to double-buffer across. Math/fp32 semantics unchanged (loop-kind only). One transient profiler 'FAIL(None)' at 0.7165 was a scoring hiccup, not a rel-L2 failure (re-run PASS 0.7170/1.755x, correct 1/1; full 5-seed correct 1/1).

Phase 3 FINAL LOCK (mamba_v5): fresh full 5-seed re-confirmation, correct 1/1, 0.7165ms/1.756x, PE61/Vec97/Scl28/DMA15/HBMrd16MB. Reproducible (0.7164/0.7165 across full runs). Phase-3 final: mamba_v5 is the promoted best at 1.756x over the 1.258ms baseline (cumulative 0.832x->1.756x, +2.11x kernel-over-kernel from mamba_v1). Beats the 1.608x ref_optimized reference by ~9%.
